author: ComradeCactus
name: anonymouspoll
short: Post a native Discord poll with a command.
description: Start a native Discord poll in the current channel using a slash command.
install_msg: Use `/anonymouspoll` (pop-up form) or `/anonymouspoll-text` to start a poll without showing who started it. Admins can use `/anonymouspoll-log` to log poll starters to a channel. Requires discord.py 2.7+ (Red 3.5.24+).
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data about users.
